note.explanation: Physics has different branches because each branch studies a particular kind of physical phenomenon. For example, optics studies visible light, while acoustics studies audible sound.
examples: A prism separating white light into colours is studied in optics.
The properties of an atom’s nucleus are studied in nuclear physics.
note.checkAnswer: Optics studies visible light; nuclear physics studies the properties of atomic nuclei.
note.simple: Physics is divided into branches. Each branch focuses on a different part of the physical world.

written.text: Q9.1. What are the main branches of Physics? State briefly.
written.finalAnswer: The main branches are mechanics, heat and thermodynamics, acoustics, optics, electromagnetism, quantum mechanics, relativistic mechanics, nuclear physics, particle physics, astronomy, cosmology and solid state physics. Mechanics studies motion and the physical effects which influence motion. Heat and thermodynamics deals with thermal energy and its flow between bodies. Acoustics deals with audible sound energy, and optics deals with visible light. Electromagnetism studies electromagnetic phenomena and the relationship between electric current and magnetic field. Quantum mechanics explains particle behaviour at atomic and subatomic levels; relativistic mechanics describes relationships between space, time, gravity and speed. Nuclear physics studies atomic nuclei, particle physics studies subatomic and elementary particles, astronomy studies celestial bodies, cosmology explores the large structure and evolution of the universe, and solid state physics studies specific properties of solid matter.

rubric.description: Briefly state what the branches study.
rubric.how: Give correct study areas for branches, such as visible light, audible sound, motion, nuclei or the universe.

modelAnswer: Mechanics: It is a study of motion and the physical effects which influence motion.
Heat and thermodynamics: It deal with the thermal energy possessed by the materials and it is used when it flows from one body to another.
Acoustics: It deals with the nature and physical aspects of audible sound energy.
Optics: It deal with the physical aspects of visible light.
Electromagnetism: It is the study of electromagnetic phenomenon and mutual relationship between electric current and magnetic field.
Quantum Mechanics: It explains the behaviour of particles at the atomic and subatomic level.

Relativistic Mechanics: It explains how space and time are not absolute quantities but related to observer. It describes the relationship between them and how they are influenced by gravity and speed.
Nuclear Physics: It is the study of the properties of nuclei of the atoms.
Particle Physics: It is the study of subatomic particles and elementary particles which are basic building blocks of matter.
Astronomy: It is study of distribution of celestial bodies like planets, stars and galaxies.
Cosmology: It explores the large structure and evolution of the universe.
Solid State Physics: It is the study of some specific properties of matter in solid form.

example.question: A prism separates a beam of light into a rainbow of colours. Which branch of Physics studies the physical aspects of this phenomenon?

explain.title: Mechanics and heat
explain.body: Mechanics: It is a study of motion and the physical effects which influence motion. It is based on Newton's laws of motion and gravitation and is often called classical mechanics. Heat and thermodynamics: It deal with the thermal energy possessed by the materials and it is used when it flows from one body to another.

explain.title: Sound and light
explain.body: Acoustics: It deals with the nature and physical aspects of audible sound energy. Optics: It deal with the physical aspects of visible light.

explain.title: Electricity, magnetism and small particles
explain.body: Electromagnetism: It is the study of electromagnetic phenomenon and mutual relationship between electric current and magnetic field. Quantum Mechanics: It explains the behaviour of particles at the atomic and subatomic level.

explain.title: Space, time, nuclei and particles
explain.body: Relativistic Mechanics: It explains how space and time are not absolute quantities but related to observer. It describes the relationship between them and how they are influenced by gravity and speed. Nuclear Physics: It is the study of the properties of nuclei of the atoms. Particle Physics: It is the study of subatomic particles and elementary particles which are basic building blocks of matter.

explain.title: Celestial bodies and the universe
explain.body: Astronomy: It is study of distribution of celestial bodies like planets, stars and galaxies. Cosmology: It explores the large structure and evolution of the universe.

explain.title: Solids
explain.body: Solid State Physics: It is the study of some specific properties of matter in solid form.

mistakes: Confusing astronomy, which studies the distribution of celestial bodies, with cosmology, which explores the large structure and evolution of the universe.
Writing that acoustics studies visible light or that optics studies audible sound; keep these two branches distinct.
Mixing up nuclear physics, which studies atomic nuclei, with particle physics, which studies subatomic and elementary particles.
Giving only a branch name when the question also says 'State briefly'; add what each branch studies.
Leaving out branches when asked for the main branches; revise the full list of twelve.
